about: Questions built for the checks of names (issue #245), for `cairnmind eval repository . --questions docs/evaluation/subject-questions.json` (see docs/EVALUATION.md). The first four have a name the checks must pass (the project's own and one it has, a name that is also a word of code (Java), a Polish request). The next five have the shapes the review named as costs: a right answer to them is withheld by the subject check when no quoted source has the name, because the name is only context (an operating system, a person) or only a word that opens a sentence (an unlisted adverb, a Polish infinitive). The last three are about things the repository does not have, written where a capital shows no name (lower case, headline case) and with a real name on a value the project does not have (Ollama's metrics port). The lower-case name rests on the model's support check and the names call; the headline-case one is read by the subject check since #394 (a name before a generic word), the real name always was. tests/test_subject.py counts, without a model, what the subject check withholds on the questions that name a file. Like everything in this directory, the file is left out of the copy that is indexed.
